products.description: The HP Smart Tank 7603 (D34F7A) is a refillable ink-tank all-in-one that prints, copies, scans and faxes, with an ADF and automatic duplex printing. HP rates it at up to 15 ppm black and 9 ppm color (ISO), with dual-band Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi Direct and USB.
products.keywords: smart tank 7603 ink tank all-in-one refillable printer wireless

specs.connectivity: Dual-band Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi Direct, Hi-Speed USB 2.0
